# Google Play: how we publish

The same developer account and service account as Skeeto (`~/dev/skeeto/docs/play.md`). The account is old, so production does not need a closed test first.

**One key for GitHub and Play.** The app signing key in Play is **our** key, `~/.config/rezina/release.jks`. It is uploaded once with PEPK, not generated by Google. As a result, the APK from GitHub Releases and the app from Play have the same signature: either one installs over the other, and Play updates GitHub installs. Never let Play generate its own app signing key. That happens if an AAB is uploaded before the key is set.

```
tools/aab                         → app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab (bump versionCode first)
tools/play listing | images       → store/listing-en-US.json, store/icon-512.png, store/feature-en-US.png, store/screens/en-US/
tools/play release internal|production [--draft]   notes from store/notes-en-US.txt
tools/play status
```

## Once, by hand in Play Console

1. **Create the app.**
   - Name: "Rezina Loop Machine".
   - Default language: en-US.
   - App or game: App.
   - Free.
   - Package: `it.automate123.rezina`.
2. **App signing key: before any AAB is uploaded.**
   1. Go to Test and release → App integrity → Play app signing → "Use a different key" / "Change app signing key", then choose "Export and upload a key from Java keystore".
   2. Download `pepk.jar` and the encryption public key into `~/.config/rezina/`.
   3. Run:
      ```bash
      java -jar ~/.config/rezina/pepk.jar --keystore=$HOME/.config/rezina/release.jks --alias=rezina \
        --output=$HOME/.config/rezina/pepk-out.zip --include-cert --rsa-aes-encryption \
        --encryption-key-path=$HOME/.config/rezina/encryption_public_key.pem
      ```
      It asks for the keystore password twice; the password is in `~/.config/rezina/keystore-password`.
   4. Upload `pepk-out.zip`.
3. **Service account.** If `tools/play status` answers 403, grant `play-publisher@play-publisher-123automate.iam.gserviceaccount.com` access to this app.
4. **App content.**
   - Privacy policy: `https://github.com/serg123e/rezina-loop-machine/blob/main/PRIVACY.md`.
   - Ads: none.
   - App access: everything is available without login.
   - Content rating (IARC): a music tool, nothing to declare.
   - Target audience: 13+.
   - Data safety: no data is collected or shared.
5. **Store settings.**
   - Category: Music & Audio.
   - Contact: `go@123automate.it`.
   - Website: the GitHub repo.

## Console automation

Play Console can be driven from a terminal through a Chrome with a debug port and a copy of the profile signed in to the account:
1. Copy `~/.config/google-chrome/Profile 7` together with `Local State` into a scratch directory.
2. Start Chrome with `--remote-debugging-port=9222 --user-data-dir=<copy> --profile-directory="Profile 7"`.
3. Connect Playwright with `connect_over_cdp`.

Notes on driving it:
- Pages are slow. Wait 10+ s after `goto`.
- Each declaration has a button whose `aria-label` is `Start <name> declaration`.

App id in Console: `4975946927447524594`. Its pages live under `…/developers/9174548521177826933/app/4975946927447524594/`.

## Status (2026-11-21)

- **Created.** The app was created in Console with automatic protection turned **off**, because it would add an installer check to Play builds and nag GitHub installs.
- **Signing key.** Play generated its own signing key at creation. It was replaced with our key through PEPK, and the fingerprint is `B1:B0:51…`, the same as the GitHub releases.
- **App content.** All declarations are done:
  - privacy policy;
  - no ads;
  - no sign-in;
  - no advertising ID;
  - not a government app;
  - no financial or health features;
  - audience 13+;
  - no data collected or shared;
  - IARC "All other app types" with all answers "No", which gave PEGI 3, ESRB Everyone, 3+.
- **Listing.** Category Music & audio. The listing, art and contacts were set via the API.
- **Countries.** All 178.
- **In review.** Production **0.2** (versionCode 2) is in review together with all the store changes.
- **Waiting: 0.3** (versionCode 3, the portrait screen made optional so tablets are not excluded) is saved in production but **not yet submitted**. Send it from Publishing overview once 0.2 is approved, because sending it during the first review would restart that review.
